title: Apple beats Q3 estimates as iPhone revenue jumps 12%
content: Apple Inc (AAPL) reported quarterly revenue well above analyst expectations, driven by stronger-than-expected iPhone sales in China and record services revenue.

title: Tesla shares slide after another round of price cuts
content: Tesla (TSLA) cut prices on its Model Y and Model 3 lineups for the third time this quarter, fueling investor concern about eroding margins amid slowing demand.

title: Nvidia unveils next-gen AI chip, analysts raise price targets
content: Nvidia (NVDA) announced its next-generation data center GPU at a developer conference, prompting several Wall Street analysts to raise price targets citing accelerating AI infrastructure demand.

title: Microsoft, Amazon cloud growth slows in latest quarter
content: Both Microsoft (MSFT) Azure and Amazon (AMZN) AWS reported cloud revenue growth below prior guidance, raising questions about enterprise IT spending in the current macro environment.

title: Boeing faces fresh delivery delays after supplier quality issue
content: Boeing (BA) said it will pause deliveries of a key 737 MAX variant after identifying a quality issue at a key fuselage supplier, extending an already difficult stretch for the plane maker.

title: Coca-Cola reaffirms full-year guidance, in line with expectations
content: Coca-Cola (KO) reported quarterly results broadly in line with consensus and reaffirmed its full-year outlook, with management citing steady demand across most international markets.

title: Meta shares jump on ad revenue beat and cost discipline
content: Meta Platforms (META) posted better-than-expected advertising revenue and signaled continued cost discipline, sending shares sharply higher in after-hours trading.

title: Intel shares fall on weak foundry outlook
content: Intel (INTC) shares dropped after the company issued a disappointing revenue forecast for its foundry business, adding to concerns about its turnaround timeline against rivals like Nvidia and AMD.
